notes.title: Crash fix and engine update
notes.notes:
Hope you're doing well!

This game has not had an update for a long time, and I appreciate a streamer reaching out to kick me into gear with a crash fix.  Here are the things that got updated:


 Crash fixes have been solved if you start an AFK mode game but no one joins.
 On Minesweeper 100, the lobby countdown won't start until someone joins a game.  If you're a streamer and want to test before you go live, type !join into the chat.
 This will be applied to AFK versions of all games shortly.
 I've updated to the new subscription version of GameMaker Studio 2.  There are some big differences under the hood, and all my updates seem to be working properly.  I've been doing a ton of testing, but anything's possible.  Shoot me an email if you see anything weird.  Messages on Steam don't notify me at all and it's the worst.


One last announcement is that I'll be removing access to Bombertown in a future update.  Try as hard as I might, the stream delay makes it impossible for the game to work as intended.  It feels like Bomberman, but slowed down to a crawl.  I'll leave a secret command in case you really want to see how bad it is, but I'd rather try to put in a new game, like a 100-player rock paper scissors tournament.  We'll see if I can take the time to make that happen.

That's all for now!  I appreciate all of you that have continued to give the game a try and provide feedback.  These games continue to get better as more people play them on stream.

All the best!
-Jaime

notes.title: New game will be added next week. Features and bug fixes added today!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

I hope you had a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!  I'm back from vacation and working on a new game that will be added to this pack next week.  It's called Splat Chat, and it's an extremely simple game where heavy objects fall from the sky each round, and everyone needs to pick a random square to move to and hope they survive.  The games it's closest to are Perfect Match in Fall Guys and It's the Pits in Mario Party.  Imagine a very, very simple version of this, supporting 100 players:

[previewyoutube=gDvwqDyzlew;full][/previewyoutube]

I'm really far in development, but the beta version is not done yet.  It should be in your hands by the end of next week.

I also fixed a massive connection bug, where sometimes the 2-factor authentication would fail and you'd be stuck.  It took me months to figure out, but hopefully it's gone forever.

Outside of all the work on that, the biggest change is actually adding buttons on screen for arrow key movement for Minesweeper Extreme: 100.  Hopefully this makes it easier for people to figure out how to control their character (WASD won't work because D is for Dig) when they are juggling a million things on stream.

Other fixes in version 0.51 are

[olist]
 Fixed a bug where 2-factor authentication would die and the game would be stuck
 More UI cleanup on Minesweeper Extreme: 100
 Way more translations have been added for French/Spanish/Korean
 Added art and animation for keyboard keys
 Lots of code cleanup and art cleanup
[/olist]


To all of you that have invited me into your streams to check out the games and provide feedback, thank you so much.  It's because of you that these games are getting better and things are getting fixed.  Keep the feedback coming!

That's all for now and I hope you enjoy the latest update.

All the best!
-Jaime

notes.title: Language improvements, and bug fixes today
notes.notes:
Hey there!

I have to run and watch more Great British Bake Off Christmas Edition, so there are small updates for today.  But I think they'll make things better for you and your streamers.

List of changes in version 0.49:


Minesweeper Extreme: 100 won't let viewers run off the map by typing a letter without a number ("!A" or "!C" instead of "!A5" or "!C4").  No escaping is allowed.
Minesweeper Extreme: 100 now forces viewers to type an exclamation point when entering a command.  so "!A5" or "!C4" instead of "A5" or "C4".  It was leading to too many accidental movements.  This has made Captain Goose unhappy, but I'll correct that soon.
More language translation work for the main menu through joining the lobby.  Still more work to do!


As always, I love to get feedback.  Let me know how I can make the game better for your stream and I'll do my best.

That's all for now and I hope you enjoy the latest update!

-Jaime

notes.title: A Happy Tanksgiving Update!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

More improvements are coming down the pipe, and I've got one I'm really happy to highlight: when someone in the chat wins a game of Happy Tanksgiving, they will get a crown in all future games of Happy Tanksgiving!  This is the first real piece of the high-score and stats section that I've been able to fully implement, and now that it is rock-solid, I'll be able to start making more improvements to that system.  One day I hope to give people special awards that carry over from game to game, or give them cool visual effects.  If you have any cool ideas for stats you'd like to see, or awards to achieve, I'm all ears.

Latest changes in version 0.42:

[olist]
When someone in the chat wins in Happy Tanksgiving, they get a crown that stays with them forever.  Thanks, AWS!
Fixed a bug where the cursor would change to the "ping player" cursor in the wrongs spots.
The crown in Happy Tanksgiving looks more like an actual crown
The lemon-colored tank also looks more like an actual lemon.
Code cleanup and improvements on my AWS systems
[/olist]

That's all for now and I hope you enjoy the latest update!

All the best!

notes.title: Soft Locking Bombertown and improving Happy Tanksgiving in version 0.41
notes.notes:
Hey there!

I'm getting some rapid-fire changes in that have been on my mind for a while and here's where we're at today:

After watching waaaaaay too many people try to play Bombertown with a handful of viewers, it's clear that the game is just not going to work with a small number of players, especially when that game has the most difficult UI to navigate.

For the sake of not creating another poor experience for smaller streamers, I have decided to soft lock the game content, and it will unlock once 20 people or more play Happy Tanksgiving.  Once that is done a single time, Bombertown will always be playable.

In terms of what to hit next, I think another quick win I can get done is to have a permanent record of every player that gets a win, so that they will always have a crown when they play (instead of during a single session - right now, their crown resets when the game closes).

I'm also considering a mode for Happy Tanksgiving that makes the game more like Robo-Rally.  Everyone plugs in a long list of commands for their hovertank, and then the game executes everyone's commands in order while the streamer tries to survive.  I think there's a lot of potential there for chaos and entertainment.

All changes in version 0.41:

[olist]
I don't know how I missed this for so long, but I have correctly updated the game's icon in the Windows Taskbar.
Bombertown is now unlocked once 20 people or more play Happy Tanksgiving.
More alerts for important or rare events (example: The person who killed the streamer gets killed by someone else) are sent to the Twitch Chat during Happy Tanksgiving.
More debugging information is being stored.  Twitch made a change to their API and I'm still trying to nail it down.
The end game awards and stats have been updated and improved for Happy Tanksgiving.
[/olist]

That's all for now!  Let me know if you've got any feedback or feature requests and I hope you enjoy the latest update!

All the best!
-Jaime

notes.title: Happy Tanksgiving - Making more sense in version 0.40
notes.notes:
Hello there!

You'll be pleased to know that Happy Tanksgiving has gotten a little bit of an update related to clarity.  Now, the boardgamefightclub bot will provide updates and friendly reminders about things that players and streamers might forget.  It's not a huge change but it does make things a little more clear.  It'll also provide updates when the streamer gets murdered by a viewer.  One additional benefit of this: if someone who doesn't speak English is playing, they can click the "translate" button on their browser and get better instructions for what to do in real time.

One thing that is taking me much longer than expected is remembering your Twitch connection so you don't need to reconnect every time.  At this very moment, I can't enable the feature because someone can use my bot to spam another channel.  I need to find a way to safely remember your connection without allowing someone to trick the system in this way.  Once it's good and safe, I'll flip the switch.

Other changes in this new version (0.40):

[olist]
If you mute the music, the game will remember this even if you quit the game and reload.
Lots of small messages have been added to Happy Tanksgiving to make things clearer for viewers and streamers.
The game logos have turned into arcade cabinets so it looks slightly more professional, and gives the players a better idea of what they will play, which are basically arcade games.
[/olist]

As always, let me know if you've got any feedback or feature requests and I hope you enjoy the latest update!

All the best!
-Jaime

notes.title: A Happy New Year update and our DMCA situation
notes.notes:
Happy New Year!

There was a big uptick in people playing today so if one of those people was you, I hope you and your viewers enjoyed the game.  This little early access game keeps getting better as more people play it and tell me what is right/wrong, so keep the feedback coming!

I've got some bigger changes on the way, specifically, adding some better on-boarding instructions/tutorial for streamers and the chat.  Some viewers and streamers figure the games out quickly and other groups don't, and that's a failing on my part.  Regardless, because of the sudden uptick in people playing I wanted to quickly patch in some fixes.

DMCA:

If you're familiar with the Twitch DMCA situation, some streamers have gotten DMCAed because of licensed audio in the games they stream.  Here's the situation for this game:  Last year I spoke with SOCAN, and because the incredible band Couteau Papillon owns all their masters, Couteau Papillon fully control all their music, not the record companies.  Which means the band is the only group that would have a legitimate DMCA claim.  The band has done video game music before (notably the Spaceteam soundtrack), and while it cost a pretty penny to license the music and get a new song created, they understand that the game is designed to be streamed and everything is in the clear for this game and for streaming their music over Twitch.

Changes in this new version (0.38):

[olist]
The music is way quieter!!  Gamemaker Studio has a huge problem with game audio, and despite the song file being properly leveled against other music, I had to crank it down to get it to sound normal.
One thing that I didn't catch in the massive GameMaker Studio update, was that sometimes Steam would say that it couldn't find the exe, except that the exe was like.... totally there.  That is fixed now!
Other quick fixes to minor bugs I found have been implemented.  I don't have a large streaming audience so it's really, really tough for me to test without having 100 real people playing at once.  Luckily, my bug-reporting systems are pretty good!
[/olist]

One thing that's still on my todo list:

With Happy Tanksgiving and Bombertown, Streamers start the lobby with some protection until the lobby closes and the game starts.  But with Minesweeper 100, it's actually possible for a streamer to dig a space before the lobby closes, discover it's a mine, and kill themselves.  And if people are still joining the lobby, the board can expand and reset the space to undug, and now it looks like they got killed for no reason.

This is a terrible experience so it's my highest priority right now, and I may have to simply lock the controls until the game starts.  Either way, it'll get fixed.

That's all for now, and I wish you a happy 2021!

-Jaime

notes.title: Minesweeper 100 - More Danger, More Fun in version 0.36
notes.notes:
This is something I'm super exited to share.

There is now a nuke under the Minesweeper 100 board.  If all the mines aren't defused within 7 minutes, the nuke goes off and kills everyone.

You may be wondering why this is!  There is a bit of a scaling problem with the game when people die.  While I can shrink the battlefield for Happy Tanksgiving and Bombertown, you can't really do that for minesweeper.  I thought that having an earthquake occur occasionally (exploding a random mine) would be a solution, and while I still like that feature, it makes survivors become very cautious and methodical.

Which makes the game take way longer.

This game is designed to be fast - in and out, explode and jump right back in.  So I've now set a 7 minute timer to force people to move fast or die.

Since I don't have a big Twitch audience, I'm excited to see how this works in other streams.  As always I'm happy to receive feedback and I hope you enjoy playing with your community!

Other changes in this new version (0.36):

[olist]
GameMaker Studio 2 released a massive update this month that changed the way a lot of things worked.  And it also broke a bunch of stuff.  The conversion is complete, and the game is more stable because of all the changes I need to make.  Hopefully I got all the bugs, and I'm so sorry if something slipped through.
Added more custom tank bullets, minesweeper flags, and hats for streamers and viewers
[/olist]

All the best!
-Jaime

notes.notes:
I've got a small update but it's a good one:  Bombertown now has a map that shrinks over time.  It's the last piece needed to give it the battle royale treatment, and games will now end faster, and get more intense as time goes on.  No more Bombertown games that drag out forever.

Keep me posted if there's something you want changed/added.

All the best!

notes.title: Version 0.33 Is Live!
notes.notes:
I hope you have been well and thanks again for playing my game!

A major milestone was hit this week: For the first time ever, a streamer was able to fill all the games with 100 players!  And everything held up perfectly (no crashes or slowdowns)!  It was really amazing to finally see the game come to live in the environment it was literally designed for, and these games really do get more fun as you get closer to 100 players.

As more and more people are playing these games, I'm getting lots of feedback on what people want to see.  Bombertown has absolutely been the one game in the pack that has needed more love, so I gave it some attention in this update!  We still need a way to shrink the map and force the game to end, but a lot of things have been improved and I'll keep making these games better.

Updates:

Happy Tanksgiving:

When the streamer tank dies, the Health indicator is removed so it doesn't cover the "Kill Mode" button


Minesweeper 100:

Added a new streamer flag


Bombertown:

Actually finished building the board so breakable powerup walls appear when there are more than 50 players
The fire from the bombs no longer kills powerups.  We want fast, chaotic games, not long drawn out boring ones
The fire from the bombs no longer hides the streamer
Drill powerups and health powerups are much more rare now
Streamer bomb and fire power change from icons to "x8" at the right time now.  No more excess icons that escape the UI.
Kill Mode button doesn't linger around after the game ends like an awkward teenager
If the streamer dies before the game starts, there won't be weird bugs


Don't forget, I still make custom tombstones and hats for Happy Tanksgiving, so if you want to look super cool when your favorite streamer plays (and actually find yourself easily in the chaos), hit me up.

That's all I got for now - if there's anything you'd like me to make a priority, let me know!

All the best,
-Jaime

notes.title: Version 0.32 Is Live!
notes.notes:
To all of you that have purchased and played the game on your channel while everyone has been so cooped up inside, you have my sincerest thanks.

I noticed a problem where some streamers flew through the opening instructions and didn't allow the bot to speak in their channel.  That bot actually provides a lot of important instructions to the viewers in the twitch chat, so if that's missing, there can be a lot of confusion for everyone.  I've reworked that beginning connection section so it

A.  Makes more sense
B.  Feels like you're hacking into an old computer terminal from the early 90s

I'm happy with the result so far and I've already got some ideas for how to make it better.

Smaller fixes have been made to kill little annoyances here and there, and my hope is to tackle some of the larger issues sooner than later.  On my shortlist are...


 Actual volme/mute controls for the music
 Getting Bombertown's UI in sync with the other games
 Fixing the resolution (it can get weird on a 4K monitor which I don't currently have)


Let me know if any of those (or anything else) is a priority for you and I'll get it on the list.

Thanks!
-Jaime

notes.title: Version 0.31 Is Live!
notes.notes:
What a week!  People have been getting the game and playing it, and I immediately found things in the UI that needed to be fixed.

The major change in this update is that the Streamer UI for Happy Tanksgiving and Minesweeper 100 has gotten a major rehaul.  There are now buttons for all the actions a Streamer can take, and the buttons are all in places that make sense.  I also fixed a minor bug where the music loop was ignoring mutes, and I did some other code cleanup.

Also, I've gotten like 10 emails from "Streamers" that stopped streaming 3 years ago, with emails structured almost identically, asking for Steam Keys.  Is there like, an online class for how to con Steam Keys out of developers?

Anyways, if you're one of the people that tried out my game and you saw something that needs correcting (or just doesn't feel right), let me know and I'll add it to the list!

All the best,
-Jaime

notes.title: Version 0.30 Is Live!
notes.notes:
Controller support is finally here!  I've gotten Gamemaker setup to accept either Xbox controllers (Xinput) or regular controllers (DirectInput, like the PS4 controllers) to control your character if you happen to have one plugged in.

Other than that, there are some more improvements:


The Hovertanks actually hover!  This is animated and it makes Happy Tanksgiving look more alive.
There is now a hyperlink that you can click on to buy the music in the game!  The link in the game leads you to the licensed song here.  Thanks again to Couteau Papillon for the amazing music.
Screenshake has been added to more places where it makes sense to have it.
Added a bunch of secret tanks to Happy Tanksgiving.  Good luck finding them!
The Twitch link system is even clearer now - and it uses colored text to highlight that something important needs to happen.


If you've tried out the game and seen something that needs correcting (or just doesn't feel right), let me know and I'll add it to the list!

All the best,
-Jaime

notes.title: Version 0.29 Is Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I have spent a ton of time this week polishing the game and fixing a ton of things that have driven me crazy for so long.  The goal is to get things polished and simple and clean, and I feel really really good about where things stand with this release.

The full list of bug fixes and improvements:


There is now an actual title screen once you connect Twitch!
Viewers are now prevented from moving/shooting/digging before the game actually starts.  All the games are better for it.
Started the process for storing player/streamer stats
Fixed all the buttons.  Literally all of them.
Fixed the twitch connection interface to be clearer and smoother
Added a button that lets a streamer start the game immediately if they so choose
Adjusted the audio levels
Minesweeper 100 now screenshakes as the seismic activity gets closer to blowing up a mine
Totally fixed the viewer sprites in Bombertown (little things here and there were a few pixels off)
Fixed the viewer chat commands displaying at the wrong time in Bombertown
Lowered the viewer HP in Bombertown.  Smaller games just took too long and extra lives are readily available.
Added a rainbow team color to Happy Tanksgiving and Minesweeper 100
Code update to optimize the chat commands when players join


Play the game and see something that needs correcting?  Let me know and I'll add it to the list!

All the best,
-Jaime

notes.title: Version 0.28 Is Live!
notes.notes:
I'm slowly chipping away at improvements, and the biggest one in this update is that the menu now has a licensed song from the Montreal-based band Couteau Papillon!  For those that are unfamiliar, the band's leader did all the music for Spaceteam, which is one of my all time favorite games.  The song I've included, Quetzalcoatl, is a jam that fits the vibe of the game really well.

In terms of bug fixes and improvements:


 Multiple streamers have gotten in-game customizations made for their channel.
 The opening instructions to connect to the Twitch chat are now much clearer.
 After a year and a half, I finally got hovertank damage to animate at the proper speed.
 I fixed the Bombertown sprites showing up in the wrong place.
 The hype quotes have been randomized so they don't all show up at once and look cluttered on the menu screen.


Notice anything that needs correcting?  Let me know and I'll add it to the list!

All the best,
-Jaime
